mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_company c JOIN sys_company_type t ON t.type_code = c.type_code WHERE t.subject_type = 'HQ') AS hqCompanyCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_company c JOIN sys_company_type t ON t.type_code = c.type_code WHERE t.subject_type = 'SERVICE') AS serviceCompanyCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_company c JOIN sys_company_type t ON t.type_code = c.type_code WHERE t.subject_type IN ('HQ', 'SERVICE') AND c.status = 1) AS enabledSubjectCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_company c JOIN sys_company_type t ON t.type_code = c.type_code WHERE t.subject_type IN ('HQ', 'SERVICE') AND c.status = 0) AS disabledSubjectCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_user u WHERE u.is_deleted = 0) AS userTotal, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_user u WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1) AS enabledUserCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_user u WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.status = 0) AS disabledUserCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_role r) AS roleCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mb.product_code) FROM machine_barcode mb WHERE mb.product_code IS NOT NULL AND mb.product_code <> '') AS productCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_dict_data dd WHERE dd.dict_type = 'service_mode') AS serviceTypeCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_dict_data dd) AS dictItemCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_region sr) AS regionCount

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(f.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS dayKey, COUNT(1) AS countNum FROM work_order_flow f JOIN work_order w ON w.id = f.work_order_id WHERE f.to_company_id = #{query.accessContext.currentCompanyId} AND f.action_type IN ('CREATE', 'TRANSFER') AND f.create_time >= #{query.startTime} AND f.create_time < #{query.endTime}
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(f.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY dayKey ASC
